_comment: Routes are presentational visitor experiences. They hold no geometry; their member segments remain the only geometry on the map.
Each route entry needs authored fields: id, name, segments, segment_directions, shape, difficulty, description, and status.
Route length, elevation gain/loss, and the complete elevation profile are derived at load from member-segment data; do not cache those generated values here.
For an out-and-back route, derived distance and elevation totals include the return trip.
Routes reference segments only. Do not add route membership back onto segment features or merge segment coordinates into route geometry.
